notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility update
notes.notes:
While we are waiting for Steam's own verification process, here's what you need to know about running Mørkredd on your Steam Deck.

This game plays great on Steam Deck, and all features works as intended. You may experience some frame-drops and performance issues, but you can easily change graphics quality within the game's settings to improve that. We plan on setting a suitable default quality setting in the future.

notes.title: Minor update to remove the Aspyr launcher window
notes.notes: Now the game will launch automatically without going to the Aspyr launcher window first.
